patterns.name: greet() uses English by default
patterns.description: The module-level helper greets in English when no language is given.
patterns.assertion: The returned string uses the English prefix.

patterns.name: Greeter falls back to English on an unknown language
patterns.description: An unrecognised language code is not an error — it falls back to English. This is the package's intended behavior, and a consumer test asserting a raise would be wrong.
patterns.assertion: No exception is raised and the English prefix is used.
